{{Quote|Where are we?''"<br />"''The old Imperial Palace on Coruscant. Medical wing. They had to do some reconstruction of your neural pathways. Don't you remember?|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[Zakarisz Ghent]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''medical wing''' of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was a fully stocked and state of the art [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] which serviced the Palace during the regimes of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
Erected within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the regime of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], this [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] was fully stocked and equipped with the finest medical equipment in the Empire. When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] the planet in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] and ousted all Imperials, the fledgling government made the Palace their base. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] the former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], was brought to the Palace's medical facility to recover from wounds she had received to her neural pathways.<ref name="TLC" />
